title: Undo history
hints: `history_push` gets `Step **head` (the address of the caller's head pointer) because it has to *change* which node the caller's list starts at.

Push: `malloc` a node, fill in `action`, point its `next` at the old head (`*head`), then make `*head` point at the new node. Free: walk the list, but save `next` **before** you free the current node.
`while (head != NULL) { Step *next = head->next; free(head); head = next; }` — reading `head->next` after `free(head)` is a use-after-free.
